title: How Bitcoin Actually Works (Explained Simply)
alts: 10,000 Bitcoin for 2 Pizzas: How Bitcoin Actually Works
Bitcoin Explained: Why There Will Only Ever Be 21 Million
line1: How does bitcoin actually work? Someone paid 10,000 BTC for two pizzas, now worth about $840 million. Here's the whole system, explained simply.
summary: Dave's cousin Kevin bought bitcoin at the $126,000 top and lost a third of his money, so Dave sets out to understand what bitcoin really is. We go from Satoshi Nakamoto's 2008 whitepaper to the blockchain as a shared notebook, bitcoin mining as a puzzle lottery, the 21 million cap and the 2024 halving, Bitcoin Pizza Day, the price history and crashes, the 2024 spot bitcoin ETFs, lost private keys, crypto scams, and the energy debate from both sides. This is the final episode of Series 2.
learn: What Satoshi Nakamoto's 2008 bitcoin whitepaper actually proposed
How the blockchain works, explained as a shared notebook
What bitcoin mining is and why it works like a puzzle lottery
Why there will only ever be 21 million bitcoin and how halvings work
Why the bitcoin price is so volatile, from pizza day to the 2025 record
How to spot crypto scams and why a lost private key means lost money
